senses.gloss: m. (γλωσσόκομον, v. LXX, II Chr. XXIV, 8; as to ד for ג׳, v. Liddell & Scott s. lit. Δ) case, chest, coffin. Y. Sot. VII, 22ᵈ כמין גלוסקום a kind of casing; Y. Shek. VI, 49ᵈ bot. גלוסקוים (corr. acc.).—
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Gittin 3:3">Gitt. III, 3</cite> if he found the document <he>בג׳ …</he> Ar. (ed. <he>בד׳</he>) in a case; expl. ib. 28ᵃ <he>טליקא דסבי</he> a box for elders (for keeping documents &c.); <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 1:8">B. Mets. I, 8</cite> Y. ed. <he>ג׳</he> (<cite ref="Bava Metzia 20a:5">B. Mets. 20ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Metzia 20b:4">20ᵇ</cite> a. Mish. <cite ref="D00001"><he>ד׳</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Moed Katan 24b:2">M. Kat. 24ᵇ</cite> (<cite ref="D00001"><he>ד׳</he></cite>) <he>ג׳ הניטלת באגפיים</he> a coffin carried by its handles.—Pl. <he>גְּלוֹסְקְמִין</he>, <he>גְּלוֹסְקְמָאוֹת</he>, <he>דְּ׳</he>.
<cite ref="Megillah 26b:8">Meg. 26ᵇ</cite> <he>דְּלוֹסְקְמֵי ספרים</he> (Alf. Ms. <he>קְמָאוֹת …</he>, ed. <he>סקאות …</he>) cases for books &c.—
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 30:1">Ex. R. s. 30</cite>, end <he>פותח הגלוסקאות</he> (corr. acc.) he opens the cases (containing his goods).
